title: Singing Games-Western Style
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Creative Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Watch a class or recorded performance of a Western singing game and talk about it.

skills.key_step: The child names the participants, costumes and props of a Western singing game and tells a costume from a prop.

floor.question: Name one Western singing game.
floor.answer: any of: London Bridge, The farmer's in his den

steps: What do they hold or use?

board.do: Show a child holding a scarf.

misconceptions.ask: In "The farmer's in his den", the farmer wears a hat. Is the hat a costume or a prop?
misconceptions.repair: Sort cards: things worn (costume) and things held or used (props).

misconceptions.ask: Who are the participants in a singing game?
misconceptions.repair: Ask: who is singing and moving?

misconceptions.ask: Can a singing game be played without props?
misconceptions.repair: Play a ring game with no props.

misconceptions.ask: In "London Bridge", who makes the bridge?
misconceptions.repair: Watch the game: count who holds the arch.

checks.question: Is a hat worn in a game a costume or a prop?

skills.key_step: The child says what a singing game is about and what it teaches.

floor.question: What do you do in London Bridge?
floor.answer: walk under a bridge of arms

representations: the words of the game song
contexts: a performance at a school event

board.do: Sing a verse: "this is the way we wash our clothes".
What is the whole game about?
The jobs we do every day.

listen_for: we walk round in a ring
misconceptions.ask: What is the message of "Here we go round the mulberry bush"?
misconceptions.repair: Ask: what jobs does each verse show?

misconceptions.ask: Where is London Bridge in the song?
What can a singing game teach?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what happens if one child does not take turns.

misconceptions.ask: What is "The farmer's in his den" about?
misconceptions.repair: Sing the verses: the farmer wants a wife, a child, a dog.

checks.question: What is "Here we go round the mulberry bush" about?
checks.answer: the jobs we do every day

checks.question: Name one thing a singing game teaches.
checks.answer: any of: working together, taking turns
